usedFor: Microsoft To Do holds personal tasks, and Todoist receives each “New Task” through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Microsoft To Do, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: Tasks added in Microsoft To Do show up in Todoist with a title and details.

watchOut: “New Task” is checked on a schedule, so expect a short wait before the Todoist task appears.
